environmentVariables.description: Analytics datasource URL (postgres, mysql, clickhouse, snowflake, duckdb, bigquery, salesforce). Optional — falls back to a bundled NovaMart SQLite demo when unset.
environmentVariables.name: ATLAS_DATASOURCE_URL

environmentVariables.description: LLM provider: anthropic, openai, bedrock, ollama, openai-compatible, gateway. Optional — the MCP server does not call an LLM directly (the client does); set this only if you also run Atlas's chat or scheduler.
environmentVariables.name: ATLAS_PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: URL of a running Atlas API. Optional — defaults to http://localhost:3001. When set, the MCP server inherits the API's connections, semantic layer, and governance.
environmentVariables.name: ATLAS_API_URL

server.title: Atlas of Plant Based: PCT data

server.description: Search Angela Kamer's coastal house plans by beds, sq ft, lot width, pilings and elevator.

server.title: Ship.com

server.name: io.github.Atlasent/mcp-server
server.description: Atlasent for AI agents: with an API key, actions wait for approval with signed proof. No key: demo.
server.title: AtlaSent MCP Server

environmentVariables.description: Atlasent API key: sign up free at console.atlasent.io and choose Connect an AI agent. Leave blank for the local demo mode.
environmentVariables.name: ATLASENT_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Atlasent API base URL. Defaults to the hosted SaaS endpoint.
environmentVariables.name: ATLASENT_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: remote (default when an API key is set) or local (in-process rules engine, no API calls)
environmentVariables.name: ATLASENT_MODE

headers.description: Bearer token minted in-app by an ATLASS OS business owner or admin (Connected Agents panel). Scoped to 67 permission scope groups; revocable instantly.

server.name: io.github.AtomGraph/web-algebra
server.description: Composable Linked Data and SPARQL operations, and LinkedDataHub content tools
server.title: Web Algebra

environmentVariables.description: Path to the LinkedDataHub client certificate (PEM), for authenticated requests
environmentVariables.name: CERT_PEM_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Password of the client certificate
environmentVariables.name: CERT_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key, used by SPARQLString to write queries
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY

server.name: io.github.Atomic-Mail/mcp
server.description: Programmable email inbox for AI agents — JMAP, PoW auth, stdio MCP server.
server.title: Atomic Mail

environmentVariables.description: Override default credential directory (~/.atomicmail/)
environmentVariables.name: ATOMIC_MAIL_CREDENTIALS_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Existing API key — skips PoW registration
environmentVariables.name: ATOMIC_MAIL_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Override auth service base URL
environmentVariables.name: ATOMIC_MAIL_AUTH_URL

environmentVariables.description: Override JMAP API base URL
environmentVariables.name: ATOMIC_MAIL_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: Default inbox domain when inboxId has no @ (default: atomicmail.ai)
environmentVariables.name: ATOMIC_MAIL_INBOX_DOMAIN
